text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 86 से 88 तक ‘One-Way Ticket-I’ पढ़ो। फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 86 se 88 tak ‘One-Way Ticket-I’ padho. Phir jawab do.
text.en: Read ‘One-Way Ticket-I’ on pages 86 to 88 of your book. Then answer.

steps.question: What does Kishto wear?
options: a long khadi kurta and short pyjamas
steps.answer: a long khadi kurta and short pyjamas
steps.modelAnswer: Kishto wears a long khadi kurta, perhaps his father's, and pyjamas that are too short for his long legs.

modelMeaning.hi: किश्तो लंबा खादी कुर्ता पहनता है, शायद अपने पिता का, और ऐसा पायजामा जो उसकी लंबी टाँगों के लिए छोटा है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Kishto lamba khaadi kurta pehenta hai, shaayad apne pita ka, aur aisa pyjama jo uski lambi taangon ke liye chhota hai.

steps.question: Who is a chatterbox?
steps.modelAnswer: Bishni is a chatterbox. She is bold too.

modelMeaning.hi: बिशनी बातूनी है। वह निडर भी है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bishni baatooni hai. Woh nidar bhi hai.

steps.question: What does Lambu always do?
options: He butts in and asks silly questions or gives childish ideas.
steps.answer: He butts in and asks silly questions or gives childish ideas.
steps.modelAnswer: Lambu always butts in and asks silly questions or gives childish ideas.

modelMeaning.hi: लंबू हमेशा बीच में बोलता है और बेतुके सवाल पूछता है या बचकाने सुझाव देता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Lambu hamesha beech mein bolta hai aur betuke sawaal poochhta hai ya bachkaane sujhaav deta hai.

steps.question: Why is Krishan called the wise?

questionMeaning.hi: कृष्ण को समझदार क्यों कहते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Krishan ko samajhdaar kyon kehte hain?

options: He helps everyone find a solution to their problems.
steps.answer: He helps everyone find a solution to their problems.
steps.modelAnswer: Krishan is called the wise because he helps you find a solution to anything you cannot solve.

modelMeaning.hi: कृष्ण को समझदार कहते हैं क्योंकि जो बात कोई हल न कर सके, उसका हल वह निकाल देता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Krishan ko samajhdaar kehte hain kyonki jo baat koi hal na kar sake, uska hal woh nikaal deta hai.

steps.question: Describe Gittoo's dress. How does he keep everybody informed?

questionMeaning.hi: गिट्टू के कपड़े कैसे हैं? वह सबको ख़बर कैसे देता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Gittoo ke kapde kaise hain? Woh sabko khabar kaise deta hai?

options: He wears khaki and gathers news and gossip from the whole village.
He wears a dhoti and reads newspapers.
He wears a kurta and writes letters.
steps.answer: He wears khaki and gathers news and gossip from the whole village.
steps.modelAnswer: Gittoo is always dressed in khaki. He plays the policeman and postman, gathers news and gossip from the whole village and keeps everyone informed.

modelMeaning.hi: गिट्टू हमेशा ख़ाकी कपड़े पहनता है। वह पुलिस और डाकिए का खेल खेलता है और पूरे गाँव की ख़बरें इकट्ठा करके सबको बताता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Gittoo hamesha khaaki kapde pehenta hai. Woh police aur daakiye ka khel khelta hai aur poore gaon ki khabrein ikattha karke sabko bataata hai.

steps.question: What do the children plan after the bus breaks down?

questionMeaning.hi: बस ख़राब होने के बाद बच्चे क्या योजना बनाते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bus kharaab hone ke baad bachche kya yojana banaate hain?

options: to walk to the fair and come back by the morning bus
to wait for a new bus
steps.answer: to walk to the fair and come back by the morning bus
steps.modelAnswer: After the bus breaks down, they plan to walk to the fair and return the next day by the morning bus.

modelMeaning.hi: बस ख़राब होने पर वे पैदल मेले जाने और अगले दिन सुबह की बस से लौटने की योजना बनाते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bus kharaab hone par woh paidal mele jaane aur agle din subah ki bus se lautne ki yojana banaate hain.

steps.question: Why does Krishan suggest going on foot?

questionMeaning.hi: कृष्ण पैदल जाने का सुझाव क्यों देता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Krishan paidal jaane ka sujhaav kyon deta hai?

options: The bus has broken down and they still want to see the fair.
steps.answer: The bus has broken down and they still want to see the fair.
steps.modelAnswer: Krishan suggests going on foot because the bus has broken down and they still want to see the fair.

modelMeaning.hi: कृष्ण पैदल जाने को कहता है क्योंकि बस ख़राब है और वे फिर भी मेला देखना चाहते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Krishan paidal jaane ko kehta hai kyonki bus kharaab hai aur woh phir bhi mela dekhna chahte hain.

steps.question: What do they do to inform their parents?

questionMeaning.hi: माता-पिता को ख़बर देने के लिए वे क्या करते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Maata-pita ko khabar dene ke liye woh kya karte hain?

options: They call the postman chacha on the telephone.
steps.answer: They call the postman chacha on the telephone.
steps.modelAnswer: They call the postman chacha on the telephone to tell their parents that they are safe and will be back the next day.

modelMeaning.hi: वे डाकिया चाचा को फ़ोन करते हैं ताकि माता-पिता को बता सकें कि वे सुरक्षित हैं और कल लौटेंगे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Woh daakiya chacha ko phone karte hain taaki maata-pita ko bata sakein ki woh surakshit hain aur kal lautenge.
